about: Colgout (colchicine) 500 microgram tablets are supplied four times between February and September 2026 to a 74-year-old man, by brand name only.
Colchicine 500 microgram tablets are supplied three times from January to March 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history of a 72-year-old man.
